symbols.name: chain_from
symbols.note: Walks produce/consume chain backwards from an artifact; returns list of hop dicts; deterministic, bounded by max_hops (default 8).

claims.text: Answers 'where did this figure come from' — the question a thesis reviewer asks.
claims.why: The function returns a chain of producers and inputs, which indeed traces the origin of an artifact.

claims.text: Deterministic (sorted frontier), bounded, and it reports the hop that ran out rather than presenting a truncated chain as complete.
claims.why: Frontier is built from sorted sets; loop is bounded by max_hops; when frontier empties it breaks, and if max_hops reached it appends a truncated note.

claims.text: Walk the produce/consume chain backwards from an artefact.
claims.why: The function starts from target_rel and iteratively finds producers and their inputs.

observations.what: chain_from uses artifact_node_id and artifact_family which are not defined in this chunk.
The chain construction may miss producers that read nothing because reads.get(producer, []) is used; reads are keyed by source.
max_hops default of 8 is arbitrary and may truncate deep chains silently.
